crystal.d: [[t:832438342|Minnesota]] leads on paper, 64 to 57, but [[t:832438366|Penn State]] checks more of his boxes. Penn State's safety room is thin, and playing time is his dealbreaker. He can start early there.
crystal.call: Coin flip. We'll lean Penn State, barely.

crystal.name: T. Cannon
crystal.d: [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] has controlled this one, sitting 73 points clear of [[t:832438398|USC]]. Ohio State grades out an A+ in conference prestige, which happens to be his dealbreaker.
crystal.call: Barring a late swing, this one's done.

crystal.name: M. Gurode
crystal.d: [[t:832438366|Penn State]] (73) and [[t:832438308|Florida]] (66) are trading punches. Penn State's edge rusher room is thin, and playing time is his dealbreaker. He can start early there.
crystal.call: Gut call: Penn State. Nobody should be comfortable.

crystal.name: C. Brightwell
crystal.d: [[t:832438337|Miami]] leads [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] 161 to 128, a real but not insurmountable gap. Miami's safety room is thin. He can start early there.
crystal.call: Miami is the pick, but Ohio State isn't done.

notes.d: [[t:832438333|LSU]] has the 13th-toughest remaining schedule in FBS. Survive it and they're in.
[[t:832438383|Tennessee]] has the 11th-toughest remaining schedule in FBS. Survive it and they're in.

cfp.method: Every remaining regular-season game is simulated 4,000 times from team ratings and scoring margin (home field worth about 2.5 points). Conference title games pit the top two in each league. A committee-style ranking weighs wins, losses, strength of schedule, conference titles and the current poll. The field is the five highest-ranked conference champions plus the next seven, with byes for the top four seeds.
